name: Addons-for-WOW-1.12.1
body:
Addons-for-WOW-1.12.1 Prompt: Source code (zip)=Dowload all addons.
**MORE ABOUT MODIFICATIONS**

**!Libs** Libraries for other addons. **Atlas** Everything for dungeons: shows a map of dungeons, quests for them, drops from bosses and profit from professions. ![atlas ai](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586274/2d7f9d58-d0e0-11e6-8730-b65671e5abb3.jpg) **Aux-Addon** Replacement of the standard auction window, expanding its capabilities. ![aux-addon](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586278/40b6b6a4-d0e0-11e6-915e-849a77d1b3f0.jpg) https://github.com/KasVital/aux-addon **BGAssistRU** Handy stuff Battlegrounds **Bagshui** Sorting items in bags and in a bank, remote bank. https://github.com/veechs/Bagshui **BetterCharacterStats** Displays character statistics in one place (just like the character tab in Burning Crusade). https://github.com/pepopo978/BetterCharacterStats **Better_RaidMarker** Easy tagging. ![better_raidmarker](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586280/47bc0bfc-d0e0-11e6-8f71-d0f7ad64badf.jpg) **BigWigs** Bossmod with timers (similar to DBM). ![bigwigs](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586282/520f6112-d0e0-11e6-9356-5f2dcdbf75db.jpg) https://github.com/jrc13245/BigWigs **CallOfElements** Makes it easier to use Shaman totems. ![callofelements](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586286/5b16933e-d0e0-11e6-8034-c03c570916e3.jpg)![callofelements_2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586696/b55d4474-d0e4-11e6-926a-7fd7f25b3d52.jpg) https://github.com/MarcelineVQ/CallOfElements **ChatBar** Quickly switch between chats. ![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/22146074/87be48ae-df14-11e6-9a81-b92705282cfd.png) https://github.com/daomatys/ChatBar **DebuffTimers** Adding timers for enemy negative and positive effects. ![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/23338985/60bb40ae-fc29-11e6-8ebb-83406ecd2774.png) https://github.com/DBFBlackbull/DebuffTimers **Decursive** Quickly remove debuffs from yourself, a group or a raid. ![decursive](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586308/78c4018c-d0e0-11e6-8161-a61b66e0ef01.jpg)![decursive_2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586307/78c23050-d0e0-11e6-949a-ebf043769668.jpg) https://github.com/MarcelineVQ/Decursive **DoTimer** Tracks debuffs on the target and buffs on the character. ![dotimer_2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586313/851bd842-d0e0-11e6-870a-f746ae61ec87.jpg)![dotimer](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586312/81e04a78-d0e0-11e6-8c92-164d160aac09.jpg) https://github.com/kc8pnd/DoTimer **EasyWho** Add buttons to the Who-Frame for easy configuration of a who request **enemyFrames** Shows the enemy team's frames on the bg, as well as important debuffs on the target. ![1- 02 01 2017 114218](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586367/70fc9c2e-d0e1-11e6-98ae-2ecaf05ef567.jpg)![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/22146136/b3a52726-df14-11e6-9518-7063b3feb635.png) https://github.com/KasVital/enemyFrames **JIM CooldownPulse** Notification that your important abilities have ready for use. ![jim_cooldownpulse](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586564/86111ab6-d0e3-11e6-82ee-072338e7d549.jpg)![jim_cooldownpulse_2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586565/861131a4-d0e3-11e6-8b73-c8aa4a3bd70b.jpg) https://github.com/pushxd/JIM_CooldownPulse https://github.com/KasVital/JIM_toolbox **LoseControl** Displays a spell that causes the character to lose control. ![losecontrol](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586573/9fd1574a-d0e3-11e6-95ba-1eb764bc8e77.jpg) https://github.com/KasVital/LoseControl **MobInfo2** Calculates and displays the amount of health of the target after damage is dealt, remembers which creatures dropped certain items, etc. https://github.com/KasVital/MobInfo2 **MikScrollingBattleText** Changing the visualization of battle text. ![mikscrollingbattletext](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586591/c938390a-d0e3-11e6-899c-79f410f37bde.jpg) https://github.com/pepopo978/Vanilla_MikScrollingBattleText **PizzaWorldBuffs** Track world buffs and tents. https://github.com/Pizzahawaiii/PizzaWorldBuffs **pfUI** "Modifies the entire interface (elvUI for 1.12). ![pfui](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586612/069641de-d0e4-11e6-8c26-331d840e69d9.jpg) https://github.com/shagu/pfUI **pfQuest** The best addon for quests. https://github.com/shagu/pfQuest **pfQuest-turtle** Installed together with pfQuest. Addon for questson Turtle-WOW. https://github.com/shagu/pfQuest-turtle **Mail** Sending more than one item via mail, collecting all mail. ![Mail](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586622/1f6a7c16-d0e4-11e6-8577-cbc570364d8b.jpg)![postal2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586621/1f6a6410-d0e4-11e6-8076-ab31f5f570e7.jpg) https://github.com/shirsig/Mail **Outfitter** Outfitter is an equipment management addon which gives you fast access to multiple outfits. https://github.com/pepopo978/Outfitter **RecipeRadar** Assists player in finding recipes. https://github.com/Shellyoung/RecipeRadar-vanilla **SpecialTalent** Expanded talent window. ![specialtalent](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586651/52f92ca8-d0e4-11e6-995a-3bcbe3757447.jpg) https://github.com/NineTears/SpecialTalent https://github.com/NineTears/SpecialTalentUI **SP_SwingTimer** Your next auto attack bar. ![sp_swingtimer](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586659/5e5b0102-d0e4-11e6-9ae6-e76814d0873b.jpg)![sp_swingtimer_2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586660/5e5b6656-d0e4-11e6-8489-f37daf2a113d.jpg)![sp_swingtimer_3](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586658/5e5ada60-d0e4-11e6-8b0d-2d5606c1efac.jpg) https://github.com/balakethelock/SP_SwingTimer **SpamThrottle** Vanilla WoW addon to remove unwanted chat messages. https://github.com/shikulja/SpamThrottle **ShaguActions** This addon saves and restores one actionbar profile for each of the 3 skill trees. https://github.com/shagu/ShaguActions **ShaguDPS** DPS metter. https://github.com/shagu/ShaguDPS **TrinketMenu** This is a mod to make swapping trinkets easier. https://github.com/pepopo978/TrinketMenu **WIM** Convenient window for personal messages, spam filter in PM. ![wim](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/15636669/21586683/89ee1af2-d0e4-11e6-8a1f-1dae40ec5116.jpg) https://github.com/refaim/WIM **unitscan** Automatically scans for characters by name and alerts you upon finding one. https://github.com/GryllsAddons/unitscan-turtle https://github.com/RetroCro/unitscan-turtle-hc **HonorSpyTurtle** Standings PVP table. https://github.com/gwetchen/HonorSpyTurtle
